summary: SFL Corporation Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and Management's Discussion and Analysis for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, incorporated by reference into its Form F-3ASR shelf registration. Results show revenues of $576.8 million versus $557.5 million, net income of $97.2 million ($0.71 per diluted share) compared with a $21.8 million loss, an $11.5 million vessel sale gain and a $34.1 million impairment. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; this is a routine periodic reporting filing, not a special situation.
